Bank Math Master.question: ১) If a + (1/a) = 3, what is (a)<sup>3</sup> + (1/a<sup>3</sup>)?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If a + (1/a) = 3, what is (a)3 + (1/a3)?

Solution:
Given that,
 a + (1/a) = 3
⇒ {a + (1/a)}3 = 33
⇒ (a)3 + (1/a3) + 3a.(1/a).{a + (1/a)} = 27
⇒ (a)3 + (1/a3) = 27 - 9
∴ (a)3 + (1/a3) = 18

Bank Math Master.question: ২) If p + q = 12 and pq = 32, then the numerical value of (p/q) + (q/p) will be?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If p + q = 12 and pq = 32, then the numerical value of (p/q) + (q/p) will be? 

Solution:
Given that,
p + q = 12
and pq = 32

Now,
p + q = 12
(p + q)2 = 122
p2 + 2pq + q2 = 144
p2 + q2 + 2 × 32 = 144
p2 + q2 = 144 - 64
p2 + q2 = 80

Again,
(p/q) + (q/p)
= (p2 + q2)/pq
= 80/32
= 2.50

Bank Math Master.question: ৩) If p = 5 - √3 then find the value of p<sup>2</sup>.

Question: If p = 5 - √3 then find the value of p2. 

Solution: 
Given that,
p = 5 - √3
⇒ p2 = (5 - √3)2
⇒ p2 = (5)2 - 2.5√3 + (√3)2
⇒ p2 = 25 - 10√3 + 3
∴ p2 = 28 - 10√3

Bank Math Master.question: ৪) If a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> + c<sup>2</sup> + 3 = 2(a - b - c), then the value of 2a - b + c is?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If a2 + b2 + c2 + 3 = 2(a - b - c), then the value of 2a - b + c is? 

Solution: 
a2 + b2 + c2 + 3 = 2(a - b - c)
⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 3 = 2a - 2b - 2c
⇒ a2 + b2 + c2 + 3 - 2a + 2b + 2c = 0
⇒ (a2 - 2a + 1) + (b2 + 2b + 1) + (c2 + 2c + 1) = 0
∴ (a - 1)2 + (b + 1)2 + (c + 1)2 = 0 

∴ a = 1
∴ b = -1
∴ c = -1 

2a - b + c 
= 2 - (- 1) + (- 1)
= 2 + 1 - 1
= 2

Bank Math Master.question: ৭) If x - y = 2 and xy = 15 then the value of (x<sup>2</sup> + y<sup>2</sup>) is?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If x - y = 2  and xy = 15 then the value of (x2 + y2) is? 

Solution:
Given that,
x - y = 2
and xy = 15

Now,
x - y = 2
⇒ (x - y)2 = 22
⇒ x2 - 2xy + y2 = 4
⇒ x2 + y2 - 2 × 15 = 4
⇒ x2 + y2 - 30 = 4
⇒ x2 + y2 = 4 + 30
∴ x2 + y2 = 34

Bank Math Master.question: ৮) If √x = √3 - √5 then the value of x<sup>2</sup> - 16x + 6 is?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If √x = √3 - √5 then the value of x2 - 16x + 6 is? 

Solution: 
√x = √3 − √5 
⇒ x = 3 + 5 − 2.√3.√5 (Squaring both sides)
⇒ x = 8 − 2√15
⇒ x − 8 = - 2√15  
⇒ x2 + 64 − 16x = 60 (Squaring both sides)
⇒ x2 + 4 − 16x = 0
⇒ x2 + 6 − 16x = 2
∴ x2 − 16x + 6 = 2

Bank Math Master.question: ৯) If a<sup>3</sup> - b<sup>3</sup> = 56 and a - b = 2, then the value of a<sup>2</sup> + b<sup>2</sup> will be?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If a3 - b3 = 56 and a - b = 2, then the value of a2 + b2 will be? 

Solution: 
Given that,
a3 - b3 = 56
a - b = 2 

Now,
a - b = 2
⇒ (a - b)3 = 23
⇒ a3 - b3 - 3ab(a - b) = 8  
⇒ 56 - 3ab.2 = 8
⇒ - 6ab = 8 - 56 
⇒ 6ab = 48
∴ ab = 8

Again,
⇒ a - b = 2
⇒ (a - b)2 = 22
⇒ a2 - 2ab + b2 = 4
⇒ a2 + b2 = 4 + 2ab
⇒ a2 + b2 = 4 + (2 × 8)
∴ a2 + b2 = 20

Bank Math Master.question: ১০) If x = 7 - 4√3, then √x + (1/√x) =?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If x = 7 - 4√3, then √x + (1/√x) =? 

Solution:
x = 7 - 4√3
⇒ x = 4 + 3 - 4√3
⇒ x = 22 + (√3)2 - 2 × 2√3
⇒ x = (2 - √3)2  [ a2 - 2ab + b2 = (a - b)2 ]
∴ √x = 2 - √3

Again,
√x = 2 - √3
⇒ 1/√x = 1/(2 - √3)
⇒ 1/√x = (2 + √3)/{(2 - √3) (2 + √3)}
⇒ 1/√x = (2 + √3)/(4 - 3)
∴ 1/√x = 2 + √3

∴ √x + (1/√x) = 2 - √3 + 2 + √3
∴ √x + (1/√x) = 4

Bank Math Master.question: ১১) If 3x<sup>2</sup> - 2xy - 5y<sup>2</sup> is devided by (x + y) then the result is-
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If 3x2 - 2xy - 5y2 is devided by (x + y) then the result is- 

Solution:
Here, 
3x2 - 2xy - 5y2
= 3x2 + 3xy - 5xy - 5y2
= 3x(x + y) - 5y(x + y)
= (x + y) (3x - 5y) 

∴ If (x + y) (3x - 5y) is devided by (x + y) then the result is (3x - 5y)

Bank Math Master.question: ১২) If for non zero x, x<sup>2</sup> - 4x - 1 = 0, then the value of x<sup>2</sup> + (1/x<sup>2</sup>) is?
Bank Math Master.exp:
Question: If for non zero x, x2 - 4x - 1 = 0, then the value of x2 + (1/x2) is? 

Solution:
x2 − 4x − 1 = 0
⇒ x2 − 1 = 4x
⇒ x − (1/x) = 4  (divide x both sides)
⇒ {x − (1/x)}2 = 42
⇒ x2 + (1/x2) − 2.x.(1/x) = 16
∴ x2 + (1/x2) = 18

Bank Math Master.question: ১৯) Today is Sabit's birthday. One year, from today he will be twice as old as he was 12 years ago. How old is Sabit today?

Question: Today is Sabit's birthday. One year, from today he will be twice as old as he was 12 years ago. How old is Sabit today?

Solution:

১ বছর পর সাবিতের বয়স হবে = (x + 1) বছর

শর্তমতে,
x + 1 = 2(x - 12)
⇒ x + 1 = 2x - 24
⇒ x = 25
